chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'but do not give them a promise in secret unless you speak in a goodly manner'.
He said: It is the man who says to the woman before her waiting period expires, 'I promise you a house from the family of so-and-so,' in order to introduce her with the proposal.
And the meaning of His Words 'unless you speak in a goodly manner' is the introduction with the proposal, and 'do not confirm the marriage tie until the writing is fulfilled'.

key_terms.التَّعْرِيضَ بِالْخِطْبَةِ: introducing with the proposal (hinting at marriage)
key_terms.يَبْلُغَ الْكِتابُ أَجَلَهُ: until the writing (of the contract or waiting period) is fulfilled

ai.seo_question: What does 'speaking in a goodly manner' mean in the context of marriage proposal in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (as), the phrase 'goodly speech' is interpreted as a preliminary proposal (khitbah) that implies interest without creating a binding obligation, allowing for flexibility before the waiting period (iddah) concludes. The Imam clarifies that 'do not confirm the marriage tie' prohibits finalizing the nikah contract until the woman's iddah is fully complete, a key distinction in Shia jurisprudence to ensure the woman is free from her previous marriage. This hadith provides the exegetical basis for distinguishing between informal courtship and formal contractual commitment during the iddah period.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [2:235] but do not give them a promise in secret unless you speak in a goodly manner.

Heasws said: ‘He is the man who is saying to the woman before the expiration of her waiting period, ‘I promise you a house of the family of so and so, in order to introduce her with the proposal; and the Meaning of Hisazwj Words unless you speak in a goodly manner, is the introduction with the proposal, and do not confirm the marriage tie until the writing is fulfilled’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “This is concerning my question before abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the meaning of the words of Allah, "...
but you must not secretly date (make secret appointment with) such women (during their waiting period) unless you speak to them in a lawful manner.’

[2:235] He (the Imam) said, ’He is a man who speaks to the woman before she completes her waiting period saying, “I invite you for a date in the house of so and so” and to propose marriage to her and His word, “Unless you speak to them in a lawful way” is a reference to “proposing marriage”, “. . . but you must not decide for marriage until the appointed waiting period is complete...” [2:235]’”
